title: Review feedback changes the contract mid-cycle
user_prompt: 리뷰에서 에러 컨텍스트 보존이 빠졌다고 지적받았어, 반영해줘
repo_context: An IssueOps cycle already has a linked issue and plan. A reviewer left a comment that the decode error loses context, which changes the acceptance criteria.
expected_plan: adds a failing test for preserved error context
updates the issue body before continuing
expected_tdd: writes a failing test that asserts wrapped error context before the fix
expected_subagents: verifies pwd branch and HEAD before work
uses verifier or bounded review for narrow reviews
critical_failures: reports feedback cleared without replying in the review thread
skips updating the remote issue when scope changes
issue or pr/mr not written in Korean
excessive emoji in issue or pr/mr
